therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: photodynamic therapy with fluorescent light activation
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: selective destruction of malignant T-cells in cutaneous lesions
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: patients with cutaneous T-cell lymphoma (mycosis fungoides)
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: ≥50% improvement in Composite Assessment of Index Lesion Disease Severity (CAILS) score at 8 weeks

results.effect_size: 19/116 (16.4%) responders with SGX301 vs 2/50 (4.0%) with placebo
subgroup_findings: Patch lesions: 65 lesions responded with SGX301 vs 14 with placebo (p=0.0009)
Plaque lesions: 64 lesions responded with SGX301 vs 7 with placebo (p<0.0001)
results.dose_information: 0.25% SGX301 in USP Hydrophilic Ointment applied twice per week, covered by opaque bandage for 12-24 hours, then treated with 5 J/cm² fluorescent light

context.comparator: placebo (USP Hydrophilic Ointment with fluorescent light)
context.duration: 8 weeks primary endpoint, with extension cycles up to 24 weeks
